description: CM360 impression and click tracking tags on doubleclick.net /ddm/trackimp and /ddm/trackclk, whose ad and creative IDs ride as semicolon-delimited path parameters.

params.name: dc_trk_aid
params.description: It is the numeric tracking ad ID. Campaign Manager 360 flags a tracking tag as missing required parameters when dc_trk_aid is absent.
params.fix_hint: Export the tag again from Campaign Manager 360 so dc_trk_aid is present.

params.name: dc_trk_cid
params.description: It is the numeric tracking creative ID. Campaign Manager 360 flags a tracking tag as missing required parameters when dc_trk_cid is absent.
params.fix_hint: Export the tag again from Campaign Manager 360 so dc_trk_cid is present.

params.name: dc_lat
params.description: It is the limited-ads signal. Google documents dc_lat=1 when Limit Ad Tracking is on for IDFA or AdID, and 0 when it is off. Generated tracking tags leave the slot empty until the publisher fills it.
params.fix_hint: Send dc_lat=1 when Limit Ad Tracking is on, dc_lat=0 when it is off, or leave the generated empty slot.

params.name: tfua
params.description: It is the under-age signal. Google documents tfua on generated tracking ads. Exported tags leave it empty until a CMP fills it.
params.fix_hint: Send tfua=1 when the request may come from a user under 16, otherwise 0 or leave the generated empty slot.

params.name: tag_for_child_directed_treatment
params.description: It is the COPPA signal. Google documents tag_for_child_directed_treatment=1 when the request may come from a user under 13. Generated tracking tags leave the slot empty until the publisher fills it.
params.fix_hint: Send tag_for_child_directed_treatment=1 for COPPA traffic, 0 otherwise, or leave the generated empty slot.
